units.title: Fix 'Round unavailable: Unexpected token <' error in the UI
Verify: Vite config proxies /api to the backend unit tests

tests.name: Vite dev proxy > proxies /api to the backend on http://localhost:8080
tests.title: Vite dev proxy proxies /api to the backend on http://localhost:8080
tests.scenario: Given the Vite config, when the dev server proxy is read, then the '/api' entry targets http://localhost:8080

tests.name: Vite dev proxy > keeps the dev server fs.allow setting of [".."]
tests.title: Vite dev proxy keeps the dev server fs.allow setting of [".."]
tests.scenario: Given the Vite config, when server.fs.allow is read, then it equals ['..']

tests.name: Vite publicDir > serves game/public
tests.title: Vite publicDir serves game/public
tests.scenario: Given the Vite config, when publicDir is read, then it ends with /game/public

tests.name: describeRoundError: Given a SyntaxError from parsing a non-JSON body, then the message says the round service returned an unexpected response
tests.title: describeRoundError returns the not-JSON explanation for a SyntaxError
tests.scenario: Given a SyntaxError("Unexpected token '<'"), when describeRoundError is called, then it returns 'Round service returned an unexpected response (not JSON)'
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appRound.test.tsx -t describeRoundError --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: describeRoundError existing four tests
tests.title: describeRoundError keeps its existing ApiError, TypeError, and string messages
tests.scenario: Given the four pre-existing describeRoundError cases, then they still pass
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appRound.test.tsx -t describeRoundError --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: App round states: Given the round response is not JSON, when the player begins, then the header shows the explained message and no parser text
tests.title: Header shows the not-JSON explanation and no parser text when getCurrentRound rejects with a SyntaxError
tests.scenario: Given getCurrentRound rejects with SyntaxError('Unexpected token <'), when the player clicks Begin, then the alert shows 'Round service returned an unexpected response (not JSON)' and no text matches /Unexpected token/
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appRound.test.tsx --testTimeout=20000
